items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: And man, Ben has just got to come in like you're pouring water in a pitcher, you know. Everybody wanted to book that band, you know.

ctx.x: And then he had another boy named Oscar Moore, used to be like at the Dewdrop for years. I don't remember Oscar, he's a drummer. So what we did, we laid two pieces out, we laid one piece out of the band off, we just laid one piece out of the drummer, so he had a bit of drum in the head. And we just kept the piano player, we made the band a little bigger. So we got to traveling, and we had another little boy with us from here, his name was Eddie Langlois, we called him Billy Eddie, his name was Eddie Langlois. So…
